$comment: draft-07. task-dod/<task_key>.json — the CONTRACT being verified, written at task start and APPEND-ONLY thereafter (see docs/adr/0001-task-dod-defined-at-task-start.md). Separate file, separate lifecycle from done-state (which is EVIDENCE of verification). The append-only invariant is enforced structurally by dod/dod-write.sh, not by this schema — a schema cannot compare a write against the prior file. This schema pins the SHAPE: every field required, no stray keys, the two enums exact. Uses only the keyword subset hc_validate supports (type/required/properties/items/enum/const/additionalProperties/oneOf/not/minLength) — no pattern/minItems/format. 'requirements non-empty' is therefore also a writer-enforced invariant, re-asserted in test-dod.sh.
